</div>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/pdf.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  var PDF_URL = "cv/Seray_Yalaz_CV.pdf";
  var MAX_PAGE_WIDTH = 1000;
  var viewer = document.getElementById("cv-viewer");
  var pages = document.getElementById("cv-pages");
  var fsButton = document.getElementById("cv-fullscreen");
  var pdfDoc = null;
  var renderId = 0;
  var lastWidth = 0;

  // If PDF.js can't load, fall back to the browser's own PDF viewer
  function showFallback() {
    pages.innerHTML = '<iframe class="cv-frame" src="' + PDF_URL + '#view=FitH" title="Seray Yalaz CV"></iframe>';
  }

  function pageWidth() {
    var style = getComputedStyle(pages);
    var inner = pages.clientWidth - parseFloat(style.paddingLeft) - parseFloat(style.paddingRight);
    return Math.min(inner, MAX_PAGE_WIDTH);
  }

  function renderAll() {
    var id = ++renderId;
    var width = pageWidth();
    lastWidth = width;
    pages.innerHTML = "";
    var chain = Promise.resolve();
    for (var n = 1; n <= pdfDoc.numPages; n++) {
      chain = chain.then(renderPage.bind(null, n, width, id));
    }
  }

  function renderPage(num, width, id) {
    return pdfDoc.getPage(num).then(function (page) {
      if (id !== renderId) return;
      var viewport = page.getViewport({ scale: width / page.getViewport({ scale: 1 }).width });
      var ratio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;

      var sheet = document.createElement("div");
      sheet.className = "cv-page";
      sheet.style.width = viewport.width + "px";
      sheet.style.height = viewport.height + "px";

      var canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width * ratio);
      canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height * ratio);
      sheet.appendChild(canvas);
      pages.appendChild(sheet);

      var drawn = page.render({
        canvasContext: canvas.getContext("2d"),
        viewport: viewport,
        transform: ratio !== 1 ? [ratio, 0, 0, ratio, 0, 0] : null
      }).promise;

      // Keep the CV's links (email, Google Scholar, ...) clickable
      return Promise.all([drawn, page.getAnnotations()]).then(function (results) {
        results[1].forEach(function (note) {
          if (note.subtype !== "Link" || !note.url) return;
          var r = viewport.convertToViewportRectangle(note.rect);
          var link = document.createElement("a");
          link.className = "cv-link";
          link.href = note.url;
          if (note.url.indexOf("mailto:") !== 0) {
            link.target = "_blank";
            link.rel = "noopener";
          }
          link.style.left = Math.min(r[0], r[2]) + "px";
          link.style.top = Math.min(r[1], r[3]) + "px";
          link.style.width = Math.abs(r[2] - r[0]) + "px";
          link.style.height = Math.abs(r[3] - r[1]) + "px";
          sheet.appendChild(link);
        });
      });
    });
  }

  if (window.pdfjsLib) {
    pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc =
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/pdf.worker.min.js";
    pdfjsLib.getDocument(PDF_URL).promise.then(function (pdf) {
      pdfDoc = pdf;
      renderAll();
    }).catch(showFallback);
  } else {
    showFallback();
  }

  // Re-draw at the new size when the window or full screen state changes
  var resizeTimer;
  window.addEventListener("resize", function () {
    clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    resizeTimer = setTimeout(function () {
      if (pdfDoc && Math.abs(pageWidth() - lastWidth) > 1) renderAll();
    }, 200);
  });

  fsButton.addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (document.fullscreenElement || document.webkitFullscreenElement) {
      (document.exitFullscreen || document.webkitExitFullscreen).call(document);
    } else if (viewer.requestFullscreen) {
      viewer.requestFullscreen();
    } else if (viewer.webkitRequestFullscreen) {
      viewer.webkitRequestFullscreen();
    } else {
      // e.g. iPhone Safari, which can't make part of a page full screen
      window.open(PDF_URL, "_blank");
    }
  });

  function onFullscreenChange() {
    var full = !!(document.fullscreenElement || document.webkitFullscreenElement);
    fsButton.querySelector("span").textContent = full ? "Exit Full Screen" : "Full Screen";
    fsButton.querySelector("i").className = full ? "fa-solid fa-compress" : "fa-solid fa-expand";
  }
  document.addEventListener("fullscreenchange", onFullscreenChange);
  document.addEventListener("webkitfullscreenchange", onFullscreenChange);
})();
</script>
